summary: Full-stack testing of Tattvashila Ecosystem root site. Backend (FastAPI) — 8/8 pytest tests pass: /api/health, POST /api/intake (valid + persistence + boundary 600 chars), 422 rejection on invalid email / empty reflection / >600 chars / missing fields, GET /api/intake/count. Frontend (Next.js 14) — homepage loads HTTP 200, all 7 sections render with correct data-testids, nav-link-philosophy/ecosystem/journey present and clickable, Devanagari fonts (Tiro Devanagari Hindi) render correctly for तत्त्वशिला/तत्त्वपीठ/त्राक्ष/वनतत्त्व/श्रीतत्त्व. Intake form submits successfully — intake-form is replaced by intake-success showing 'Received, with care.' Mobile @390px: all sections visible, nav collapses to single 'STAY IN TOUCH' link, layout responsive. No console errors, no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Intake.tsx invalid-email path: input has type='email' so HTML5 native validation prevents submission and the React error state never fires for malformed emails — the user sees the browser's native tooltip. This satisfies the spec but the custom 'intake-error' element only ever shows the helper copy. If a more on-brand error treatment is desired, add `noValidate` on the form and surface backend 422 detail through the existing intake-error element. Not a bug.
server.py CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is permissive — acceptable for an open landing page with no auth, but worth tightening to the production origin once domain is final.
No rate-limiting on POST /api/intake — a public unauthenticated endpoint could be spammed. Consider IP-based throttling or hCaptcha before launch.
MongoDB index recommendation: db.intake_submissions could benefit from an index on `email` + `received_at` for future querying; not blocking.
Intake stores email in plaintext — fine for newsletter intent; ensure privacy/consent copy aligns when going live.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed intake records in db.intake_submissions (id, reflection, email, received_at). Approx 4 TEST_ rows added during this run; safe to leave or purge with: db.intake_submissions.delete_many({email: /^TEST_/})
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_tattvashila_api.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Stack is Next.js 14 (not CRA), public URL via NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Intake form uses native HTML5 email validation; to test backend 422 path through UI you'd need to bypass with novalidate or call API directly. All 7 section data-testids are: section-threshold/premise/philosophy/ecosystem/journey/intake/closing. Form testids: intake-form, intake-reflection, intake-email, intake-error, intake-submit, intake-success. Nav testids on desktop only: nav-link-philosophy/ecosystem/journey (hidden on mobile by design — mobile shows only 'Stay in touch').
